_about: SAMPLE, NOT THE AUTHORITY'S LIST. Every code here is printed in VSDC SPECIFICATION DOCUMENT v1.0.5 (2023-05-16): the first three in the §3.3.2.2 selectItemsClass response sample, with their names as printed; the last two on the sample restaurant items in the §3.3.4 item list response, where no name is printed. It exists so a sample database can classify a menu item and exercise ADR-050 D-m end to end. scripts/sync-rra-classifications.mjs refuses to load a *.sample.json into a database that carries no sample marker. The real list comes from the VSDC's /itemClass/selectItemsClass and is set as RRA_CLASSIFICATION_SOURCE.
